q: The Collatz map on the 2-adic integers ℤ₂ can be expressed as a continuous map. The conjecture is equivalent to:
opts: The 2-adic map has a unique fixed point
Every 2-adic integer has an orbit that passes through ℤ⁺ and eventually reaches 1
The map has no periodic orbits in ℤ₂
exp: Extending the Collatz map to ℤ₂ gives a continuous map. The conjecture is equivalent to every positive integer eventually reaching 1, i.e., every positive integer is in the basin of the fixed-point cycle {1,2} in ℤ₂.
